chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abi al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, raising it, who said:

I said to him, 'May I be made your ransom, sometimes someone whom I fear is present with me, so it is not possible to place the palm-stalk as we have narrated.' He said: 'Insert it wherever possible.'

key_terms.الْجَرِيدَةِ: The palm-stalk placed with the deceased
key_terms.جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ: A respectful expression meaning: may I be made your ransom

ai.seo_question: What should be done if the palm-stalk cannot be placed on the deceased in the usual way?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical ruling concerning the placement of the palm-stalk with the deceased when the usual method cannot be carried out. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that it should be placed wherever possible, indicating flexibility in circumstances of fear or constraint.
